meta.window_note: Repo history (~8 weeks) is entirely inside the 6-month window; June/August are partial months.
meta.human_emails_note: 'human' = every non-AI author. Spans a local email and a GitHub-web/squash-merge email for the same person. See human_email_breakdown.
meta.contamination_note: Author = who committed, not who wrote. Human commits in Jul-Aug likely contain AI-generated code committed by the human; June is the only clean human baseline. Not corrected.
meta.merge_handling: Line metrics over non-merge commits only.
meta.rename_handling: diff -M; pure renames add no births/deaths. No -C.
meta.segmentation: By author email of the introducing commit (blame).
